resources.string: Read with the camera or select an image. Review the content before choosing an action.
Only host, port and username are included. Configure authentication in the connection editor; host keys are checked when connecting.
Commands are not run when scanned or saved. Edge buttons are added to a new disabled panel; enable it in the panel manager.
Text containing line breaks or control characters can be copied, but cannot be inserted as a command.
Could not complete the operation. Check the QR content, image, camera permission or destination.
A QR can contain up to 2,000 UTF-8 bytes here. Shorten the content if it cannot be displayed.
Offline QR generation and camera/image decoding
Share a selected file or folder directly from this device. Recipients open the QR/link in a browser, browse folders, and confirm each file before saving. No relay or cloud upload is used.

Use an address reachable from the internet, with inbound access or router port forwarding to this phone. Starting this server does not make a blocked mobile connection public. IPv6-only URLs require an IPv6 connection on the recipient.
Use a PKCS#12 certificate with a private key and chain, matching the public host and trusted by browsers. The password is not saved.
I understand HTTP does not encrypt the file or sharing URL.
Sharing active. Open or stop here.
Waiting. External access has not been confirmed; test from a different connection.
The receive page was opened. This does not prove access from every network.
Bytes sent (including retries): %1$s. Saving is confirmed on the recipient.
Could not start sharing. Check the URL, available port, file/folder access, free space and HTTPS certificate. Limits: 1 GiB total, 10,000 items and 64 levels.

Keep this device online until reception finishes. Anyone with the link can receive during the selected period. Stop, expiry, or a connection change stops the share server, closes ongoing transfers, and deletes the sending copy. Other servers are unaffected.
Could not read the shared QR content. Share up to 8 readable images containing QR codes, or text up to 4,096 characters.

Use the current Wi-Fi or mobile connection. Selecting a file or folder starts a server and creates a URL and QR code with the device address and a free port. The network or router must allow incoming connections.
Automatic sharing uses HTTP. The file and share URL are not encrypted. For HTTPS, use Manual.
Choose a file and start sharing
No public address could be obtained from the current connection. Try another connection, or use Manual if you have configured a public address and port forwarding.
The connection or address changed, so sharing and its server stopped. Select the file or folder again to create a new URL.
This is an IPv6 URL. The recipient also needs an IPv6 connection.
Choose a folder and start sharing
Folders keep their hierarchy. Recipients browse them in a browser and select individual files to receive.
